item.title: Reps Hear Continued ICE Outcry, Discuss America 250 Grants
item.description: Rep. Daniel Wilber presented a resolution from the floor in appreciation of retiring Otsego County IT Director Brian Pokorny. Pokorny worked for the county for more than 30 years and has been director of his department since January of 2000.

item.title: Bill White Wins O’Neil Award
item.description: Signed by the New York Giants in 1953, White found rapid success on the baseball diamond and helped desegregate several leagues during his time in the minors.

item.title: Otsego County Community Foundation Grant Rounds Now Open
item.description: The Community Foundation of Otsego County announced that applications are now being accepted for three grant rounds: the Otsego Lake Watershed Sustainability Fund, the Greater Otego Library and Education Fund, and the Advocates for Springfield Fund.

item.title: GOP, Libertarian Gubernatorial Candidate Campaigns in Hartwick
item.description: GOP leaders across the state have endorsed Nassau County Executive Bruce Blakeman in the race. But for some locals, Sharpe is the better choice.

item.title: Town of Hartwick Sets Public Hearing for Solar Moratorium
item.description: SolAmerica has yet to file an official application for the project, which they estimated would create 2 MW of power from 5,568 solar panels.

item.title: Cooperstown Boys Win Section Again
item.description: Top-seeded Cooperstown boys basketball won a repeat Section III Class C championship with a 74-51 victory over two-seed Cato-Meridian in Syracuse on Sunday, March 8.

item.title: Lawmakers Rail against State Climate Law; Green Groups Call State Report Inaccurate
item.description: The report from the New York State Energy Research and Development Authority estimated that “Upstate oil and natural gas households would see costs in excess of $4,000 a year” by 2031 if the CLCPA is implemented as written.

item.title: Yellowjackets Season Ends in Section Finals
item.description: Oneonta High School’s basketball team fell to Maine-Endwell Senior High School’s Spartans in the boys Class A Section Finals on Sunday, March 8
